PLCB.description: Pre-Combined Load Case (PLCB). A single global record (key is always 1) holding the list of static load cases combined into the pre-combined load; the LCNAME_ITEM array of static load case names drives the whole record.

LCNAME_ITEM.description: List of static load case names to include in the pre-combined load. Each name is resolved to an existing static load case (STLD) by the handler; supplying a non-empty list replaces the current set of load cases.
